posts.title: Start here: what is available today / 从这里开始：当前可用内容
posts.bodyText:
This is a quick guide to the project's current status:

Available now: a standalone Godot 4 client prototype, English/Simplified Chinese UI, offline demo discussions and MOD cards, and a local macOS build.
Being connected: this repository's GitHub Discussions and a static guest feed. You can already participate here in GitHub's web interface.
Not available yet: GitHub account sign-in inside the client, creating posts or comments in the client, Android/Windows/Linux builds, and MOD installation.
Future projects: Plyra Compositor and Plyra World are not released. The MOD directory is not a released ecosystem.

Use General for open conversation, Ideas & Feedback for proposals, Development for implementation, and Help & Support for questions. Check the Roadmap and Contributing guide before posting.

以下是项目当前状态速览：

当前已有： 可独立运行的 Godot 4 客户端原型、英语/简体中文界面、离线演示讨论与 MOD 卡片，以及 macOS 本地构建。
正在接入： 本仓库的 GitHub Discussions 和静态游客 Feed。你现在可以直接通过 GitHub 网页参与交流。
尚不可用： 客户端内 GitHub 账号登录、客户端内发帖或评论、Android/Windows/Linux 构建，以及 MOD 安装。
未来项目： Plyra Compositor 和 Plyra World 尚未发布；MOD 目录也不等同于已发布生态。

请在 General 进行日常交流，在 Ideas & Feedback 提交提议，在 Development 讨论实现，在 Help & Support 提问。发帖前请查看路线图和参与贡献指南。

posts.title: Welcome to Plyra Community / 欢迎来到 Plyra 社区
posts.bodyText:
Welcome! This repository is the public discussion space for Plyra. We are starting with a small, independent Godot Community client prototype and a bilingual community. Please introduce yourself, share what you are exploring, or ask a question in the category that fits best.
The current client can browse bundled demo discussions and MOD cards. GitHub sign-in, creating discussions and comments from the client, and Android/Windows/Linux builds are not available yet. The client remains independent of Plyra Compositor, Plyra World, and Steam.
Plyra Compositor, Plyra World, and a released MOD ecosystem are future work; they are not released products. The MOD directory is metadata-only and this client does not install or execute MODs.
Please read Community rules, Contributing, and Roadmap. English and 简体中文 are both welcome.

欢迎来到 Plyra 社区！本仓库是 Plyra 的公开交流空间。我们从一个独立运行的 Godot 社区客户端原型和双语社区开始。欢迎自我介绍、分享正在探索的内容，或在合适的分类中提问。
当前客户端可以浏览本地演示讨论和 MOD 卡片。客户端内 GitHub 登录、创建讨论与评论，以及 Android/Windows/Linux 构建均尚不可用。客户端可独立运行，不依赖 Plyra Compositor、Plyra World 或 Steam。
Plyra Compositor、Plyra World 和正式发布的 MOD 生态仍属于未来规划，并非已发布产品。MOD 目录目前仅收录元数据，客户端不会安装或执行 MOD。
请阅读社区规则、参与贡献和路线图。欢迎使用英语或简体中文交流。
